title: Coinbase targets first half of 2027 for its own prediction market contracts
description: Coinbase plans to offer its own event contracts to U.S. retail and institutional customers in the first half of 2027, Bloomberg reported, as the exchange builds clearing and trading infrastructure around the business.

title: Wrapped Monero token XMR1 collapses 99.8% after $13.5 million sell-off
description: XMR1, Wagyu's wrapped Monero token on Hyperliquid, fell from about $500 to near zero on Nov. 20 as a deployer-linked wallet sold $13.5 million of the asset; the operator blamed a breach at its web host.

title: MoonPay applies for OCC national trust bank charter for custody, stablecoins
description: MoonPay filed with the OCC on Nov. 17, 2026 to create MoonPay National Trust Bank in Miami Beach, a non-depository that would offer stablecoin issuance and digital asset custody under federal oversight.

title: SEC charges eight Colorado firms in $37 million fake crypto platform scam
description: The SEC charged eight Colorado-based entities with running fake advisers and crypto trading platforms that stole more than $37 million from over 1,500 US investors since August 2024.

title: VanEck to end Gemini custody and clearing agreements for three crypto ETFs
description: VanEck notified Gemini on Nov. 16, 2026 that it will terminate custody and clearing agreements for its Bitcoin, Ether and Solana ETFs on about Feb. 16, 2027, while Coinbase Custody stays on.
